description: This file implements a DiskLruCache class, which provides a disk-based Least Recently Used (LRU) cache mechanism for storing key-value pairs with byte array values. It manages cache entries with support for concurrent access, journal logging, cache trimming, and file management to maintain a bounded size cache. It also includes inner classes for managing cache entries, snapshots, and editing sessions.

classes.name: DiskLruCache
classes.description: A disk-based cache that maintains a bounded size and uses a journal file to track cache entries, supporting concurrent access, entry editing, snapshot creation, and cache trimming.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens or creates a cache in the specified directory with given app version, value count, and maximum size.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of a cache entry for the given key if it exists and is readable.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Returns an editor for the cache entry associated with the given key for modification.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the cache entry for the specified key if it exists and is not being edited.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes used in the cache.

methods.name: maxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the cache in bytes.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the cache, persisting state and releasing resources.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes all cache files and clears the cache directory.

methods.name: readFully
